set.body:
Type: implementation task (sub-task of F05.1)
Work key: F05.1.2
Parent: F05.1 (bd-01M4W5P6KGS22KR04N7W3TVZZW)
Plan: docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md (public API contract), docs/decisions/002-institutional-authority.md (Discover)

Scope: labs, projects (optionally by lab), a project's datasets and the caller's shared releases, filtered by current authority, searchable by visible name/label, ordered stably, paged with bounded limits and opaque cursors bound to principal, query and a digest of the caller's own authorized set.
Acceptance: totals count only authorized rows; a later page rechecks policy and returns an explicit 409 restart when the caller's visible set changed, never stale rows or counts; cursors from another principal or query are refused.
set.title: F05.1.2: Authorized directory pages with policy-bound cursors
